question: What comprehensive division of eightfold groups is sought to be fully known?
premises: A division consisting of eight groups of eight is indicated
The speaker seeks to know this division fully
The knowing is expressed as extending without limit
inference: The speaker seeks complete and endless knowledge of the division into eight groups of eight
uncertainties: anantathā may qualify the extent of division or the manner of knowing
plain_english: I seek to know fully and endlessly the division into eight groups of eight.
